info.title: IYA STS remote PEP
info.description: The remote XACML policy enforcement point's own API: its status overview, its liveness, the demonstration decision at /protected, the PDP's policy nudge and its own credential's CRLs. Served on the plain listener (PEP_PORT, 9090, only with PEP_HTTP=true), the HTTPS listener (PEP_HTTPS_PORT, 9443) and any listener of purpose api the service defines. With PEP_HTTP off and a CRL directory present, 9090 is a CRL-only listener that answers GET /crl/{name} and nothing else (404 STS-XPEP-0114). A method or path not listed here is 404 with the NotFound body (STS-XPEP-0009); nothing answers 405. HEAD is answered as GET without the body for every GET listed here but /protected, whose GET is a decision; HEAD /protected is that 404. Error codes are recorded in the PEP's log and never sent.

servers.description: The plain listener, PEP_PORT, with PEP_HTTP=true.

get.summary: What this PEP holds and how it is doing
get.description: The whole state of the PEP: the policy it holds and whether it is stale, its registration, the PIP, the HTTPS listener, the AuthZEN edge PDP, the reverse proxy, and every managed setting in force with its source. Reads nothing in the request. HEAD is answered as GET without the body.

Always 200 while the process answers; it says nothing about whether the policy is current (GET / says that). The image's HEALTHCHECK, xacml-pep --healthcheck, asks this over the plain listener with PEP_HTTP=true and over HTTPS, unverified, otherwise. HEAD is answered as GET without the body.

Builds an XACML request from the query with the service's request builder, decides it against the held policy (fetching the attributes the policy designates from the PDP's PIP first), applies the bias and the obligation rule of XACML 3.0 section 7.2, and answers 200 when allowed and 403 when not, with the same body. A repeated parameter keeps its last value. Every parameter not named here is a subject attribute, asserted under its own name and as urn:sts:xacml:attribute:<name>. No credential is read: the subject is what the query says. HEAD is the generic 404 (STS-XPEP-0009): a decision is evaluated, counted and reported, which a HEAD from a monitor or a link checker does not mean to ask for.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: The access-subject's subject-id. Absent or empty: no subject attribute.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The resource-id (anyURI). Absent or empty: the resource setting (PEP_RESOURCE), else urn:xacml-pep:protected.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action-id. Absent or empty: GET.

parameters.name: subjectKind
parameters.description: application says the subject is an application; any other value says user. Asserted as urn:sts:xacml:subject-kind and forwarded to the PIP.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Any other parameter: a subject attribute, under both spellings, unbounded and unchecked.

403.description: Not allowed: Deny, NotApplicable or Indeterminate under the bias, or a Permit with an obligation this PEP cannot discharge (STS-XPEP-0004). No policy held is STS-XPEP-0005; Indeterminate STS-XPEP-0006.

post.description: Answered on an HTTPS listener only. Says that something may have changed: nothing in the request is checked, and of the body (at most 4096 bytes) only full is read, which asks for every document whole and carries nothing a pull does not fetch. The PEP answers at once and then pulls; the outcome shows on GET / as holding.lastNudgeAt and lastNudgeResult (a failed pull is STS-XPEP-0010).

requestBody.description: What the service sends. A body that is not JSON, or has no full: true, is an ordinary nudge; any body is answered alike.

204.description: Accepted; the pull follows. No body and no Content-Type; Cache-Control: no-store.

404.description: On a plain listener (STS-XPEP-0112): the PDP nudges over https only. On the CRL-only listener, STS-XPEP-0114.

get.summary: A CRL of this PEP's own credential
get.description: The file {name} in PEP_CRL_DIR (default: the crl directory beside PEP_TLS_CERT), as stored, so that a client verifying this PEP's certificate can check it. Served on every API listener, the CRL-only one included. HEAD is answered as GET without the body.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A file name; anything else is 404.

200.description: The CRL's bytes, as the file holds them (normally DER). No Cache-Control.

404.description: No CRL directory, a name of another form, or no such readable file (STS-XPEP-0009); only error is sent.

error_description.description: Absent on a CRL lookup that found nothing.

PipReport.description: What the PIP did for the last evaluation. One of seven forms: used is false with why (PIP off; no subject; no designators, with subject; too many designators, with subject and designators; the query failed or its answer was unreadable, with subject, designators and failed), or used is true with subject, designators, resolved and unresolved.

lastQuery.description: The last evaluation's report, the reverse proxy's included; null before any.

asksForClientCertificates.description: What the listener does: the acceptor it serves asks callers for a certificate (PEP_AUTHZEN_CLIENT_CA or trust anchors set, and its tuning's askClientCertificate or requireClientCertificate on); before it serves one, what its tuning will build.

obligationsProfile.description: The realm's authzen.obligationsProfile, as pulled. The default, and an absent member, is on.

enabled.description: Whether the edge PDP answers: the value in force, the service's managed authzen when it set one, else PEP_AUTHZEN (settings.values.authzen says which).

clientCertificatesAsked.description: https.asksForClientCertificates: whether the environment's HTTPS listener asks. Admission asks the listener each request arrived on.

pdpIdentifier.description: The identifier in force: the service's managed authzenPdpIdentifier when it set one, else PEP_AUTHZEN_PDP_IDENTIFIER; null when neither is, and the metadata names the origin each request arrived at.

byStatus.description: Answers by HTTP status, the status as the key.

signals.description: Null when the proxy is not running.

root.description: The root policy's id, "(unnamed)" when it has none; null when none is held.

lastChangeCause.description: start, poll, nudge, heartbeat or unnamed; empty before any change.

RegistrationNotify.description: The service's register answer's notify member, passed through as it came (POST /xacml/pep/register). The PEP reads usable and why.

Registration.description: registered false: name, attempts and why. registered true adds authenticated and notify.

SettingValue.description: One managed setting in force: its value (typed by its key), where it came from, and rejected: true on a notifyUrl that was set and refused, whose value is then the refused string.

values.description: Every managed setting, by key: description, resource, notifyUrl, bias, pip, pollIntervalMs, heartbeatIntervalMs, backoffMaxMs, timeoutMs, maxBodyBytes, httpsReloadIntervalMs, logLevel, authzen, authzenPdpIdentifier, authzenForwardTimeoutMs, the proxy's settings and the decision records' (auditEnabled, auditIntervalMs, auditBatch, auditBuffer).

instance.description: This process's id, which a batch carries so the service can tell two instances under one name apart.

AuditStatus.description: The decision records this PEP sends to the service's audit log (#1827): POST /admin-api/pep-audit, with its DPoP-bound token for /admin-api. Delivery is at least once; dropped counts records lost to a full queue (PEP_AUDIT_BUFFER) or to a batch the service refused as malformed.

lastRefusal.description: Why the last token request was refused; null when none was.

keySource.description: The variable the key came from: PEP_ASSERTION_KEY, else PEP_TLS_KEY.

subject.description: PEP_NAME: the username of this PEP's entry.

clientCertificate.description: Whether PEP_TLS_CERT is presented as well.

tokens.description: By audience: xacml-pep, admin-api and access-v1.

CredentialStatus.description: How this PEP authenticates to the service (#1827): a DPoP-bound access token per audience, from an RFC 7523 self-assertion signed with one key, which signs every DPoP proof too.

stale.description: lastPullAt is empty, unreadable, or older than staleAfterMs.

notify.description: The https notify URL in force; null when none is, or the one set was refused.

message.description: Absent, not null, when the engine gave none.

syncToken.description: The policy set's sync token; empty before any pull.

note.description: Present only when no root policy is held (STS-XPEP-0005).

pdp.description: The realm's PDP: the base /xacml/pep/* is served under, realm prefix included — pinned, or that of the request that made the change; empty only with neither. Not read by the PEP.

full.description: true on a Sync from the console: pull every document whole rather than answered 304. Honoured at most once a poll interval (STS-XPEP-0120 logs one asked for sooner, which pulls as usual); absent, false or any other value is an ordinary pull.

Nudge.description: What the service sends (POST, https only, the PEP's certificate verified against the realm's pep-tls chain, redirects not followed) after a commit to the policy repository, to every member of a cluster whose configuration changed, and on a Sync from the console. The PEP reads full alone and trusts nothing else in it.
